text: I am writing in my capacity as Chair of the Toronto Police Service Board regarding the Auditor General’s report entitled Audit of the Toronto Police Service’s Information Technology Governance: Driving Improved Accountability and Transparency in Achieving Technology Objectives. At its public meeting on May 14, 2026, the Toronto Police Service Board considered the Auditor General’s report and adopted the recommendations directed to the Board. The Board appreciates the Auditor General’s work and recognizes the importance of strong information technology governance, accountability, transparency, and effective oversight in supporting the Toronto Police Service’s operations and service delivery.
